verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200 at docs.lium.io/llms.txt), and a second llms.txt exists at lium.io with agent-directed instructions. The docs add further agent-oriented access: raw markdown for any page via `.md` or `Accept: text/markdown`, a docs MCP server with `search` and `read_page` tools, a dedicated agents page, and an official agent SKILL.md. First-party docs plus hands-on confirmation cover every element of the story.
